world_solid.summary: World structure: one closed convex solid; renders, collides, seals and blocks visibility

prop_static.summary: Fixed placement of an existing model; never sealing world structure

prop_dynamic.summary: Movable or animated model entity; not part of profile version 1

prop_physics.summary: Runtime physics body from an existing model and its own collision

entity_point.summary: Geometric entity with a transform and no geometry

entity_brush.summary: Geometric entity owning one closed convex solid

light.summary: Baked point light from an unshaped UsdLux SphereLight

errors.stage.open-failed: The root layer does not exist or does not parse
errors.stage.profile-missing: The root layer's customLayerData has no sourcemap profile record
errors.stage.profile-version: The declared profile or version is not source-authoring version 1
errors.stage.default-prim-missing: The root layer declares no valid defaultPrim
errors.stage.units: metersPerUnit is not authored on the root layer, or is not positive
errors.stage.up-axis: upAxis is not authored on the root layer, or is not Y or Z
errors.composition.error: USD reported a composition error (unresolved sublayer, reference or prim path); prim checks are not run
errors.composition.units-mismatch: A contributing layer authors metersPerUnit or upAxis different from the root layer
errors.schema.compiled-data: A prim carries RFC 0008 compiled World Stage data (source: properties or Source*API schemas)
errors.feature.unsupported: Instancing, point instancers, time samples or an unsupported prim type
errors.role.missing: Geometry, a light or sourcemap: data without a declared sourcemap:role
errors.role.name-only: A prim whose name looks like a role or entity class but declares no role
errors.role.unknown: The declared role is not in the profile
errors.role.unsupported: The role is known but reserved for a later profile
errors.role.prim-type: The role's prim has a type the role does not accept
errors.role.children-unsupported: A role prim has descendants other than materialBind face subsets
errors.property.missing: A required role property is absent
errors.property.type: A sourcemap: property has the wrong value type
errors.property.value-unsupported: A token value is outside the role's supported values
errors.property.unknown: A sourcemap: property the role does not declare
errors.id.missing: A role prim has no sourcemap:id
errors.id.invalid: The id does not match the profile's id pattern
errors.id.duplicate: Two role prims on the composed stage share an id
errors.id.role-changed: An id from the previous revision now names an object of another role
errors.transform.non-finite: The local-to-world transform has a non-finite element
errors.transform.singular: The local-to-world transform has a zero determinant
errors.transform.not-rigid: The role requires a rotation and translation only
errors.geometry.missing: A solid role is not a Mesh or has no faces
errors.geometry.subdivision: A solid's subdivisionScheme is not none
errors.geometry.non-finite: A solid has a non-finite point
errors.geometry.degenerate-face: A face has fewer than three distinct in-range vertices or no area
errors.geometry.non-planar-face: A face's vertices do not lie on one plane
errors.geometry.non-manifold: An edge is used twice in the same direction
errors.geometry.open: An edge has no opposite edge: the solid is not closed
errors.geometry.inside-out: The closed solid encloses negative volume for its orientation and transform
errors.geometry.non-convex: A vertex lies in front of a face plane (this also rejects concave faces of a closed solid)
errors.geometry.coplanar-faces: Two faces lie on one plane; each face must be one brush side
errors.surface.ids-missing: A world solid has no sourcemap:surfaceIds
errors.surface.ids-invalid: surfaceIds has the wrong length or a negative value
errors.surface.ids-duplicate: surfaceIds repeats a value within one solid
errors.uv.missing: A world solid has no primvars:st
errors.uv.invalid: primvars:st is not vertex or faceVarying, or has the wrong length
errors.uv.not-affine: A face's st is not one non-degenerate affine function of position
errors.material.missing: A world-solid face resolves to no bound Material
errors.material.invalid: The bound Material has no valid sourcemap:material, or its face subsets are invalid
errors.prop.model-missing: A prop role has no sourcemap:model
errors.prop.model-invalid: sourcemap:model is not a relative models/...mdl game path
errors.entity.class-missing: An entity role has no sourcemap:classname
errors.entity.class-unsupported: The classname is not supported for the entity role
errors.light.type-unsupported: The light is not an unshaped SphereLight
errors.light.inputs: intensity or color is not authored, or intensity is not positive
errors.map.player-start-missing: The composed stage has no info_player_start
